title: feat(spec,cli): reports are translatable — `reports` in the translation bundle
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi3q9Cxq5D2UNgBbGKBFEtdp)_

Fixes #25788

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Ruling-ref: none; triage first grade 6397355491 (a protocol addition under the standing order, p1)

_Body refreshed 2026-10-26T02:56Z, after the `ui/` merge (#25825): the console half now ships in this PR._

## What

A translation bundle can now carry reports:

```ts
reports: { opps_by_stage: { label: '各阶段商机', description: '按阶段汇总的商机' } },
```

Before, an app's reports listed in the authoring language on the console's report index and report page under any locale: the bundle had no key for a report (`reports` was a retired object-first dialect key, so `os validate` refused it), and `os i18n check` reported 100 % with zero report keys (HotCRM, `✓ All 1691 translation keys covered`).

- **`@objectstack/spec` (`system/translation.zod.ts`):** a `reports` group on the shared per-app shape, so the bundle entry (`TranslationData`), the registered `translation` item and the platform bundle all accept it. Keyed by the report's `name` and closed at `label` / `description` (strict: `name` / `title` are refused with a message pointing at `label`, and the singular `report` with a message pointing at `reports`).
- **`@objectstack/spec` (`system/i18n-resolver.ts`):** `translateReport`, registered in `METADATA_DOCUMENT_TRANSLATORS`. `TRANSLATABLE_METADATA_TYPES` is derived from that table and `@objectstack/rest` reads it, so `GET /meta/report` (list and item) is served in the request's locale. A key the bundle does not carry leaves the authored string, and an untouched document keeps its reference.
- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol` + `@objectstack/rest`:** a report is overlay-editable (ADR-0126 Regime O), so like `dashboard` and `view` its translator honours the packaged base (ADR-0029 D9.2a): `getPackagedReportBase(name)` returns the shipped document under any overlay, and `PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS` hands it to the translator. A label an org re-authored is served as written; the strings it did not touch are still translated.
- **`@objectstack/spec` (liveness ledger):** `translation/reports` added as `live`, with drilled `label` / `description` children, seeded with its reader.
- **`@objectstack/cli`:** `os i18n extract` walks `reports[]` (`walkReports`), and `os i18n check` / `os lint` coverage report a gap in its own bucket (`i18n/missing-report`). Every key is recorded with `pushOptional`, so a description nobody wrote is never demanded.
- **`@objectstack/lint`:** `translation-target-unknown` resolves each `reports.NAME` key against the stack's `reports[]` names, sibling packages' declarations included; an unknown name is an `error` with the nearest declared name. `os explain translation-target-unknown` names the leg.
- **`scripts/fixtures/i18n-walk-parity/every-group.stack.json`:** authors one report, so `check:i18n-walk-parity` sees the group walked.
- **`packages/runtime` meta-list projection census:** `report` / `reports` joined both axes; the reference-moves blocks pin the zh-CN label on both reads.
- **`examples/app-todo` (zh-CN, ja-JP), `examples/app-showcase` (zh-CN):** translations for their 5 + 4 reports. The new walk counts them; deleting one todo key grows `check:i18n-coverage` 106 → 108, so the fix was to translate them, not to raise the ratchet.
- **`ui/` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n`):** the translation designer's preview draws the `reports` group as a "Reports" / 「报表」 category beside the others, and the console's translation loader recognises a payload that carries only `reports`.
- **Docs:** `protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx` (group list, count, leg table) and `ui/translations.mdx`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The `LEGACY_OBJECT_FIRST_KEYS` collision (the order's PM assumption), decided:** `reports` leaves the list. `authored-translation-sync` skips every stored translation row that carries one of those keys as a retired dialect, so a declared group still on the list would parse in a file and never load from a Studio-authored row. The legacy object-first dialect never used `reports` (zero footprint, #3778), so nothing loses its retired-key diagnostic. Its `TRANSLATION_KEY_GUIDANCE` entry goes with it. A test pins the removal.
- **Deviation from the precedent's shape (and the reason):** #25701 touched spec, cli and lint only, because positions and permission sets are not overlay-editable. A report is (ADR-0126 Regime O), so a translator that ignored the packaged base would overwrite an org's re-authored label with the catalog string, the #20680 defect class. Hence the two extra packages (`metadata-protocol`, one accessor; `rest`, one table row), inside the claim's "runtime meta translation path".
- **The console half ships in this PR (#25859, transferred here from objectui#13543).** Since #25825 moved objectui into this repo as `ui/`, `Type Check UI` and `Test UI` build against this tree's `packages/spec`, so the console's exhaustive copies of the group list have to move with the group or this PR is red. The copies are:
  - `TranslationPreview.tsx`'s `CATEGORY_DEFS` (`satisfies Record<keyof TranslationDataSchema['shape'], …>`), with its en / zh label keys in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`;
  - `spec-translations.ts`'s `SPEC_TRANSLATION_GROUPS`, pinned by `loadLanguage.test.tsx`;
  - the two hand-pinned tests: `TranslationPreview.categories-11765` (`ONE_ENTRY`) and `adminPreviews.i18n-10862-s2` (its key list, and the `2/13` denominator becoming `2/14`).

  The report surfaces themselves (the report index `appReportIndex.ts`, the page heading `ReportView.tsx`, the header crumb `AppHeader.tsx`, the recent-items label `useRecentItemLabel.ts`) read the server-translated `GET /meta/report` and need no change. The earlier sequencing question (the scheduled `Console Pin Gate` going red until a `.objectui-sha` bump) went away with the pin (#25745). `ui/` reads neither `LEGACY_OBJECT_FIRST_KEYS` nor `TRANSLATION_KEY_GUIDANCE` (`git grep` at `da49afeb6c`: no hits). This PR does not carry `Fixes #25859`, because the claim gate requires a claim naming this branch; #25859 closes after the merge.
- **Out of scope, recorded:** a joined report's `blocks[].label` (`ui/report.zod.ts`, an `I18nLabelSchema`) is not on the face, so `showcase_task_overview` will show a translated heading over its block labels as authored. The card asks for `label` / `description` only.
- No `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm, so no full dogfood run is owed.
- **Receipts for the comments on this PR before this refresh:**
  - Docs drift 6400121514: `i18n-standard.mdx` and `translations.mdx` are updated in this PR. `concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` names no packaged-base accessor, so `getPackagedReportBase` changes nothing it says.
  - Contract review 6400225090 ③.3 (a joined report's `blocks[].label` has no key) is a follow-up for the seat to file, recorded above as out of scope.
  - Contract review ③.4 and the seat's 6400446674 ("landing held for the owner's sequencing choice") are superseded. With the console half in this PR there is no main-red window to sequence: no `Console Pin Gate`, no `.objectui-sha`.

## Verification

**After the `ui/` merge, at head `378f52336f`** (main merged a third time at `bbb49e33f1`, clean, then the `ui/` port `da49afeb6c` and the sdui re-record `378f52336f`). Every result is exit 0.

- **ui vitest** over the touched surfaces (`TranslationPreview*`, `adminPreviews.i18n-10862-s2`, `packages/i18n/src`, `apps/console/src/loadLanguage.test.tsx`), run from `ui/`: 91 files, 1424 passed, 13 skipped.
  - Ablation: with the `ui/` half stashed, the three pinned files fail 19 tests in 2 files, and app-shell `tsc` reports TS1360 at `TranslationPreview.tsx:103` (`CATEGORY_DEFS` does not satisfy the record of 14 groups). With the port, that error is gone. The stash was popped and `git diff` was empty afterwards.
- **ui i18n gates:** `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:spec-symbols` and `check:icon-record-names` passed.
- **`check-sdui-manifest`:** the `ui/packages/i18n` source edit moved the in-tree registry digest, which reddened `Lint · repo & tooling gates` on `da49afeb6c`. `scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` regenerated it. `sdui.manifest.json` is byte-identical (sha256 `1f6e1ccb925a…`, 106 components); only the record's `registrySourcesSha256` and `generatedAt` moved. The gate now passes, locally and in CI.
- **`dispatch-gates --commands`** derived 135 families, the same list at `da49afeb6c` and `378f52336f`. Each ran with its exit code captured before any pipe: 134 at `da49afeb6c` and the sdui gate again at `378f52336f`, all 135 exit 0. `--ran` reports 135 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- **Local environment note:** this clone's incremental install (from before the ui merge) left `@types/react` unhoisted, so `@object-ui/components`' declaration build failed locally on three third-party typings in files this PR does not touch. The generator ran after `@types/react` and `@types/react-dom` were hoisted locally; no install change is committed. `ui/packages/components/` is unchanged from `main`, where `Type Check UI` builds it green.

**Before the `ui/` merge,** all at head `ac2bcb0ba` (main merged twice, the second clean) unless noted. Every result is exit 0.

- **Package suites** (spec, runtime, objectql, metadata-protocol and rest `test:repo` on `a79e5bc2`; rest `test`, lint and cli on `f6725a90`, before the first merge):
  - `@objectstack/spec`: `test` 21849 passed, `test:repo` 1269 passed.
  - `@objectstack/runtime`: `test` 7100 passed, `test:repo` 947 passed.
  - `@objectstack/objectql`: `test` 8723 passed.
  - `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: `test` 21490 passed.
  - `@objectstack/rest`: `test` 6737 passed, `test:repo` 280 passed.
  - `@objectstack/lint`: `test` 7302 passed.
  - `@objectstack/cli`: unit project 4848 passed.
- **After the second merge, at `ac2bcb0ba`:** spec `src/system` (1974), the cli report walk (4), lint `validate-translation-references` (209), rest explicit-override (76), runtime projection census (878) and the new objectql accessor file (5) re-ran green, and spec `tsc --noEmit` passed.
- **`typecheck`** passed for `spec`, `cli`, `lint`, `rest`, `metadata-protocol`, `runtime`, `example-todo` and `example-showcase`.
- **`dispatch-gates --commands`** at `ac2bcb0ba` derived 134 families. A full `turbo run build` came first. Each family ran with its exit code captured before any pipe, and all 134 exited 0. `--ran` reports 134 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
  - `check-engine-split-ratio --days 90` first refused (exit 2) because the clone was shallow. After `git fetch --shallow-since=2026-07-20` it passed.
- **`check:i18n-coverage`:** OK, 527 baselined, none new. `--update` moved nothing.
  - Control: deleting one `zh-CN` report key in app-todo turns it red (106 → 108), then the file was restored.
- **`check:i18n`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`** (14 declared, 12 walked, 2 exempted), **`check:generated`:** green.
- **Ablation.** Each step was run, then restored to the HEAD blob, with `git diff` empty afterwards:
  - Deleting `report: translateReport,` turns `i18n-report.test.ts` red (2 of 16 failed).
  - Deleting the `walkReports(config, out);` call turns `i18n-report-walk.test.ts` red (4 of 4 failed).
  - Deleting the `['report', 'getPackagedReportBase']` row turns the REST explicit-override file red (9 failed: §1 and every §4 edited-label cell).
- **Independent review** (the spec rule): an isolated Fable subagent ran three rounds, each APPROVE_WITH_NITS. Every finding is fixed, filed or recorded. Rounds 1 and 2 (the whole diff, then its fixes) are #25788 comment 6399284479. Round 3 (the merge, the `ui/` port and the re-record) is #25788 comment 6407105388; its one nit is that `378f52336f`'s message credits app-shell as well as i18n for the digest move, when app-shell is not a registry package.
